Specification: This module provides Apalache-specific type annotations and concrete constant values for an instance of the DieHarder specification. It declares the constants Jug, Capacity, and Goal, the variable contents, instantiates the DieHarder module, and defines concrete operators JugVal and CapacityVal for use with APDieHarder.cfg.
FunctionConstructor: [ j \in JugVal |-> IF j = "small_OF_JUG" THEN 3 ELSE 5 ]
